taproot_backups.title: Backups
taproot_backups.description: Snapshots of config.yaml, taproot.yaml, the auth files, and the taproot database. They hold OAuth tokens, so keep downloads private.
taproot_backups.empty_description: Back up now, or wait for the scheduled backup.
taproot_backups.restore_lead: This puts taproot back to how it was on {{when}}.
taproot_backups.restore_step_pre: Taproot first saves the current state as a pre-restore backup, so you can undo this by restoring that one.
taproot_backups.restore_step_files: config.yaml, taproot.yaml, and the auth folder are replaced with this backup's copies. Credentials added since then are removed from the auth folder; they stay in the pre-restore backup.
taproot_backups.restore_step_db: Usage, quota, prices, and the request log index return to this backup's snapshot when taproot next starts.
taproot_backups.restore_step_restart: Taproot then restarts itself if its supervisor allows it; otherwise you restart it. Requests in flight during the restart fail.
taproot_backups.restore_type: To confirm, type the backup id
taproot_backups.pre_restore_saved: The previous state is saved as
taproot_backups.restart_back: Taproot is back up and running the restored database.
taproot_backups.restart_gave_up: Taproot has not come back after 90 seconds. Check the server.
taproot_backups.restart_manual: Restart taproot now to finish: the database is restored on the next start.
